subject: non deterministic behaviour - equijoin with outer - not able to read data

messages.author: 7e01961f1f4ce874
messages.subject: non deterministic behaviour - equijoin with outer - not able to read data
parts:
While reading data generated using equijoin with outer, R session is getting closed, I am getting this error frequently, inner join works perfectly fine 

a <- head(mtcars, n=10)
b <- tail(mtcars, n=5)
a <- cbind(a,data.frame(c=1:10))
b <- cbind(b,data.frame(c=1:5))
hdfs.rm('a.data')
to.dfs(a,'a.data')
hdfs.rm('b.data')
to.dfs(b,'b.data')
adata = mapreduce(map=function(k,v) (keyval(v$c, v)),input='a.data')
bdata = mapreduce(map=function(k,v) (keyval(v$c, v)),input='b.data')
data1 = equijoin (left.input = adata, right.input = bdata, outer = c("left"))
ah= from.dfs(data1) # Not able to read data, R session closes
